svg.title: Query-time flow from one text query to one ranked candidate output
svg.desc: One text query becomes a query embedding produced by the declared embedding model and representation version. Similarity search compares that embedding with entries of the already prepared vector index whose bindings were checked against the index manifest, and returns candidate retrieval units resolved through stable retrieval identifiers and provenance links. Those candidates form the ranked candidate output of at most the configured number k of retrieval units. The index box states its canonical binding fields: the canonical knowledge collection version, the chunking configuration that realizes the retrieval-unit definition recorded in the retrieval contract, the embedding model and representation version, the required embedding dimension and embedding space, and a stable retrieval identifier and provenance link for every retrieval unit. Similarity scores order candidates but do not establish relevance, truth, or authority. A failed binding check makes the index stale for that retrieval configuration and activates the rebuild condition before query time, and a missing compatible query embedding ends the sequence without a ranked candidate output. Index preparation, context construction, and generation are not shown.
svg.text: Query time — from one text query to one ranked candidate output
Text query
one execution under one retrieval configuration · Evaluation Case A or B
Query embedding
the declared embedding model and representation version produce it
from the text query, not from the indexed retrieval units
Similarity search over the prepared vector index
exact or approximate nearest-neighbor search under the declared measure
bindings are compared against the index manifest before use (Section 4.3)
Candidate retrieval units
at most the configured number k, ordered by similarity score
each resolved through a stable retrieval identifier and provenance link
Ranked candidate output
provenance-preserving source fragments, for example [F-A]
at most k retrieval units; no relevance judgment is included
Vector index: vector-index-case-ab-v1
the canonical knowledge collection version: course-seed-v1
the chunking configuration that realizes the retrieval-unit
definition recorded in the retrieval contract: A
the embedding model and representation version: course-embed-demo/v1
the required embedding dimension and embedding space: dimension 3 in ℝ³
a stable retrieval identifier and provenance link
for every retrieval unit: F-A (0.84, 0.26, 0.45), F-B (0.48, 0.68, 0.42)
prepared before query time; reused across compatible query executions
bindings verified against the index manifest before each use
Binding mismatch: stale index for that configuration
the Section 4.3 rebuild condition applies before query time
no query-level change repairs a stale binding
Boundaries of this flow
similarity scores order candidate retrieval units; they do not prove relevance
the human evaluator judges every returned retrieval unit
a missing compatible query embedding ends the sequence without an output
index preparation, context construction, and generation are not shown
Solid blue: query-time flow · Solid green: query embedding and prepared index supply candidates · Red: stale-binding branch (Section 4.3)
